verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦν ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ Ἰησοῦς ἀνέβη εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta ēn heortē tōn Ioudaiōn kai Iēsous anebē eis Hierosolyma
verses.literal: Some time later . . . there was a feast of the Jews and Jesus went up to Jerusalem

verses.original: δὲ Ἔστιν ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐπὶ τῇ προβατικῇ κολυμβήθρα ἔχουσα πέντε στοὰς ἡ Ἑβραϊστὶ ἐπιλεγομένη Βηθεσδά
verses.transliteration: de Estin en tois Hierosolymois epi tē probatikē kolymbēthra echousa pente stoas hē Hebraisti epilegomenē Bēthesda
verses.literal: Now there is in - Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades which in Hebrew is called Bethesda

verses.original: ἐν ταύταις κατέκειτο πλῆθος τῶν ἀσθενούντων τυφλῶν χωλῶν ξηρῶν
verses.transliteration: en tautais katekeito plēthos tōn asthenountōn typhlōn chōlōn xērōn
verses.literal: On these [ walkways ] lay a great number of the sick [the] blind [the] lame [and the] paralyzed

verses.original: δέ τις ἄνθρωπος Ἦν ἐκεῖ ἔχων ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ τριάκοντα καὶ ὀκτὼ ἔτη
verses.transliteration: de tis anthrōpos Ēn ekei echōn en autou tē astheneia triakonta kai oktō etē
verses.literal: - One man - there had been - - - [an] invalid [for] thirty-eight . . . . . . years

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἰδὼν τοῦτον κατακείμενον καὶ γνοὺς ὅτι ἔχει ἤδη πολὺν χρόνον λέγει αὐτῷ Θέλεις γενέσθαι ὑγιὴς
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous idōn touton katakeimenon kai gnous hoti echei ēdē polyn chronon legei autō Theleis genesthai hygiēs
verses.literal: - When Jesus saw him lying [there] and realized that he had spent vvv a long time [in this condition] He asked him Do you want to get well

verses.original: Κύριε ὁ ἀσθενῶν Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ ἔχω οὐκ ἄνθρωπον βάλῃ με εἰς τὴν κολυμβήθραν ἵνα ὅταν τὸ ὕδωρ ταραχθῇ δὲ ἐν ᾧ ἐγὼ ἔρχομαι ἄλλος καταβαίνει πρὸ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kyrie ho asthenōn Apekrithē autō echō ouk anthrōpon balē me eis tēn kolymbēthran hina hotan to hydōr tarachthē de en hō egō erchomai allos katabainei pro emou
verses.literal: Sir the invalid replied - I have no one to help me into the pool - when the water is stirred - While . . . I am on my way someone else goes in before me

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῷ Ἔγειρε ἆρον σου τὸν κράβαττόν καὶ περιπάτει
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Legei autō Egeire aron sou ton krabatton kai peripatei
verses.literal: Then Jesus told him Get up pick up your - mat and walk

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθέως ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐγένετο ὑγιὴς καὶ ἦρεν αὐτοῦ τὸν κράβαττον καὶ περιεπάτει δὲ Ἦν ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ σάββατον ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: Kai eutheōs ho anthrōpos egeneto hygiēs kai ēren autou ton krabatton kai periepatei de Ēn en ekeinē tē sabbaton hēmera
verses.literal: - Immediately the man was made well and he picked up his - mat and began to walk Now this happened on - the Sabbath day

verses.original: οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἔλεγον τῷ τεθεραπευμένῳ ἐστιν Σάββατόν καὶ οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἆραι σου τὸν κράβαττον
verses.transliteration: oun hoi Ioudaioi elegon tō tetherapeumenō estin Sabbaton kai ouk exestin soi arai sou ton krabatton
verses.literal: so the Jews said to the [man] who had been healed This is [the] Sabbath - vvv It is unlawful for you to carry your - mat

verses.original: δὲ ὃς ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς Ὁ ποιήσας με ὑγιῆ ἐκεῖνός εἶπεν μοι Ἆρον τὸν σου κράβαττόν καὶ περιπάτει
verses.transliteration: de hos apekrithē autois Ho poiēsas me hygiē ekeinos eipen moi Aron ton sou krabatton kai peripatei
verses.literal: But - he answered - The [man who] made me well - told me Pick up - your mat and walk

verses.original: Τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ εἰπών σοι Ἆρον καὶ περιπάτει οὖν Ἠρώτησαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Tis estin ho anthrōpos ho eipōn soi Aron kai peripatei oun Ērōtēsan auton
verses.literal: Who is [this] man who told you to pick [it] up and walk - they asked -

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἰαθεὶς οὐκ ᾔδει τίς ἐστιν γὰρ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐξένευσεν ὄχλου ὄντος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ
verses.transliteration: de Ho iatheis ouk ēdei tis estin gar ho Iēsous exeneusen ochlou ontos en tō topō
verses.literal: But the [man who] was healed {did} not know who it was for - Jesus had slipped away [while the] crowd was vvv vvv there

verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ὁ Ἰησοῦς εὑρίσκει αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἴδε γέγονας ὑγιὴς μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε ἵνα μὴ τι χεῖρόν γένηται σοί
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta ho Iēsous heuriskei auton en tō hierō kai eipen autō Ide gegonas hygiēs mēketi hamartane hina mē ti cheiron genētai soi
verses.literal: Afterward . . . - Jesus found [the man] at the temple and said to him See you have been made well Stop sinning or . . . something worse may happen to you

verses.original: ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἀπῆλθεν καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι ἐστιν Ἰησοῦς ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὸν ὑγιῆ
verses.transliteration: ho anthrōpos apēlthen kai anēngeilen tois Ioudaiois hoti estin Iēsous ho poiēsas auton hygiē
verses.literal: [And] the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well

verses.original: Καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ὅτι ἐποίει ταῦτα ἐν σαββάτῳ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐδίωκον τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Kai dia touto hoti epoiei tauta en sabbatō hoi Ioudaioi ediōkon ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: Now because . . . - [Jesus] was doing these things on [the] Sabbath the Jews began to persecute - [Him]

verses.original: δὲ Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτοῖς ἕως ἄρτι μου Ὁ Πατήρ ἐργάζεται κἀγὼ ἐργάζομαι
verses.transliteration: de Iēsous ho apekrinato autois heōs arti mou Ho Patēr ergazetai kagō ergazomai
verses.literal: But Jesus - answered them To this very day My - Father is at His work and I too am working

verses.original: οὖν Διὰ τοῦτο οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐζήτουν μᾶλλον ἀποκτεῖναι αὐτὸν ὅτι οὐ μόνον ἔλυεν τὸ σάββατον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἔλεγεν τὸν Θεόν ἴδιον Πατέρα ποιῶν ἑαυτὸν ἴσον τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: oun Dia touto hoi Ioudaioi ezētoun mallon apokteinai auton hoti ou monon elyen to sabbaton alla kai elegen ton Theon idion Patera poiōn heauton ison tō Theō
verses.literal: vvv Because of this the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him - Not only was He breaking the Sabbath but vvv He was even calling - God His own Father making Himself equal with God

verses.original: οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀπεκρίνατο καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὁ Υἱὸς οὐ δύναται ποιεῖν οὐδὲν ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ ἐὰν μή βλέπῃ τὸν Πατέρα ποιοῦντα τι γὰρ ἃ ἂν ἐκεῖνος ποιῇ ταῦτα ὁ Υἱὸς καὶ ποιεῖ ὁμοίως
verses.transliteration: oun ho Iēsous Apekrinato kai elegen autois Amēn amēn legō hymin ho Huios ou dynatai poiein ouden aph’ heautou ean mē blepē ton Patera poiounta ti gar ha an ekeinos poiē tauta ho Huios kai poiei homoiōs
verses.literal: So - Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . Truly truly I tell you the Son vvv can do nothing by Himself unless . . . He sees the Father doing [it] For whatever . . . [the Father] does - the Son also does -

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ φιλεῖ τὸν Υἱὸν καὶ δείκνυσιν αὐτῷ πάντα ἃ αὐτὸς ποιεῖ καὶ ἵνα ὑμεῖς θαυμάζητε δείξει αὐτῷ μείζονα ἔργα τούτων
verses.transliteration: gar ho Patēr philei ton Huion kai deiknysin autō panta ha autos poiei kai hina hymeis thaumazēte deixei autō meizona erga toutōn
verses.literal: - The Father loves the Son and shows Him all - He does And to your amazement He will show Him even greater works than these

verses.original: γὰρ Ὥσπερ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐγείρει τοὺς νεκροὺς καὶ ζωοποιεῖ οὕτως καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς ζωοποιεῖ οὓς θέλει
verses.transliteration: gar Hōsper ho Patēr egeirei tous nekrous kai zōopoiei houtōs kai ho Huios zōopoiei hous thelei
verses.literal: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives [them] life so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ κρίνει οὐδένα οὐδὲ ἀλλὰ δέδωκεν πᾶσαν τὴν κρίσιν τῷ Υἱῷ
verses.transliteration: gar ho Patēr krinei oudena oude alla dedōken pasan tēn krisin tō Huiō
verses.literal: Furthermore the Father judges no one . . . but has assigned all - judgment to the Son

verses.original: ἵνα πάντες τιμῶσι τὸν Υἱὸν καθὼς τιμῶσι τὸν Πατέρα ὁ μὴ τιμῶν τὸν Υἱὸν οὐ τιμᾷ τὸν Πατέρα τὸν πέμψαντα αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: hina pantes timōsi ton Huion kathōs timōsi ton Patera ho mē timōn ton Huion ou tima ton Patera ton pempsanta auton
verses.literal: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father Whoever vvv does not honor the Son vvv does not honor the Father who sent Him

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὁ ἀκούων μου τὸν λόγον καὶ πιστεύων τῷ πέμψαντί με ἔχει αἰώνιον ζωὴν καὶ οὐκ ἔρχεται εἰς κρίσιν ἀλλὰ μεταβέβηκεν ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου εἰς τὴν ζωήν
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti ho akouōn mou ton logon kai pisteuōn tō pempsanti me echei aiōnion zōēn kai ouk erchetai eis krisin alla metabebēken ek tou thanatou eis tēn zōēn
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you - whoever hears My - word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and {will} not come under judgment Indeed he has crossed over from - death to - life

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὥρα ἔρχεται καὶ ἐστιν νῦν ὅτε οἱ νεκροὶ ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀκούσαντες ζήσουσιν
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti hōra erchetai kai estin nyn hote hoi nekroi akousousin tēs phōnēs tou Huiou tou Theou kai hoi akousantes zēsousin
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you - [the] hour is coming and has now [come] when the dead will hear the voice of the Son - of God and those who hear will live

verses.original: γὰρ ὥσπερ ὁ Πατὴρ ἔχει ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτῷ οὕτως καὶ ἔδωκεν τῷ Υἱῷ ἔχειν ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτῷ
verses.transliteration: gar hōsper ho Patēr echei zōēn en heautō houtōs kai edōken tō Huiō echein zōēn en heautō
verses.literal: For as the Father has life in Himself so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself

verses.original: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν ποιεῖν κρίσιν ὅτι ἐστίν Υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: kai edōken autō exousian poiein krisin hoti estin Huios anthrōpou
verses.literal: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment because He is [the] Son of Man

verses.original: μὴ θαυμάζετε τοῦτο ὅτι ὥρα ἔρχεται ἐν ᾗ πάντες οἱ ἐν τοῖς μνημείοις ἀκούσουσιν αὐτοῦ τῆς φωνῆς
verses.transliteration: mē thaumazete touto hoti hōra erchetai en hē pantes hoi en tois mnēmeiois akousousin autou tēs phōnēs
verses.literal: {Do} not be amazed at this for [the] hour is coming when . . . all who [are] in [their] graves will hear His - voice

verses.original: καὶ ἐκπορεύσονται οἱ τὰ ποιήσαντες ἀγαθὰ εἰς ἀνάστασιν ζωῆς δὲ οἱ τὰ πράξαντες φαῦλα εἰς ἀνάστασιν κρίσεως
verses.transliteration: kai ekporeusontai hoi ta poiēsantes agatha eis anastasin zōēs de hoi ta praxantes phaula eis anastasin kriseōs
verses.literal: and come out those who have done good to [the] resurrection of life and those who have done evil to [the] resurrection of judgment

verses.original: ἐγὼ δύναμαι ποιεῖν Οὐ οὐδέν ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ κρίνω καθὼς ἀκούω καὶ ἡ ἐμὴ ἡ κρίσις ἐστίν δικαία ὅτι οὐ ζητῶ τὸ ἐμὸν τὸ θέλημα ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με
verses.transliteration: egō dynamai poiein Ou ouden ap’ emautou krinō kathōs akouō kai hē emē hē krisis estin dikaia hoti ou zētō to emon to thelēma alla to thelēma tou pempsantos me
verses.literal: I can do vvv nothing by Myself I judge only as I hear And - My - judgment is just because vvv I do not seek - My [own] will but the will of [Him who] sent Me

verses.original: Ἐὰν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ μου ἡ μαρτυρία ἔστιν οὐκ ἀληθής
verses.transliteration: Ean egō martyrō peri emautou mou hē martyria estin ouk alēthēs
verses.literal: If I testify about Myself My - testimony is not valid

verses.original: ἐστὶν ἄλλος ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμοῦ καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἡ μαρτυρία ἣν μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν ἀληθής
verses.transliteration: estin allos ho martyrōn peri emou kai oida hoti hē martyria hēn martyrei peri emou estin alēthēs
verses.literal: There is another who testifies about Me and I know that [His] testimony . . . . . . about Me is valid

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ἀπεστάλκατε πρὸς Ἰωάννην καὶ μεμαρτύρηκεν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hymeis apestalkate pros Iōannēn kai memartyrēken tē alētheia
verses.literal: You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ οὐ λαμβάνω τὴν παρὰ ἀνθρώπου μαρτυρίαν ἀλλὰ λέγω ταῦτα ἵνα ὑμεῖς σωθῆτε
verses.transliteration: de egō ou lambanō tēn para anthrōpou martyrian alla legō tauta hina hymeis sōthēte
verses.literal: [Even though] I {do} not accept - vvv human testimony - I say these things so that you may be saved

verses.original: Ἐκεῖνος ἦν ὁ λύχνος ὁ καιόμενος καὶ φαίνων δὲ ὑμεῖς ἠθελήσατε πρὸς ὥραν ἀγαλλιαθῆναι ἐν αὐτοῦ τῷ φωτὶ
verses.transliteration: Ekeinos ēn ho lychnos ho kaiomenos kai phainōn de hymeis ēthelēsate pros hōran agalliathēnai en autou tō phōti
verses.literal: [John] was a lamp that burned and gave light and you were willing for a season to bask in his - light

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ ἔχω τὴν μαρτυρίαν μείζω τοῦ Ἰωάννου γὰρ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ὁ Πατὴρ δέδωκέν μοι ἵνα τελειώσω αὐτά τὰ αὐτὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιῶ μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὅτι ὁ Πατήρ ἀπέσταλκεν με
verses.transliteration: de egō echō tēn martyrian meizō tou Iōannou gar ta erga ha ho Patēr dedōken moi hina teleiōsō auta ta auta erga ha poiō martyrei peri emou hoti ho Patēr apestalken me
verses.literal: But I have - testimony more substantial than that of John For the works that the Father has given Me - to accomplish . . . the very works - I am doing testify about Me that the Father has sent Me

verses.original: καὶ Πατὴρ ὁ πέμψας με μεμαρτύρηκεν ἐκεῖνος περὶ ἐμοῦ οὔτε πώποτε ἀκηκόατε αὐτοῦ φωνὴν οὔτε ἑωράκατε αὐτοῦ εἶδος
verses.transliteration: kai Patēr ho pempsas me memartyrēken ekeinos peri emou oute pōpote akēkoate autou phōnēn oute heōrakate autou eidos
verses.literal: And [the] Father who sent Me has Himself testified . . . about Me vvv vvv You have never heard His voice nor seen His form

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἔχετε αὐτοῦ τὸν λόγον μένοντα ἐν ὑμῖν ὅτι ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε τούτῳ ὃν ἐκεῖνος ἀπέστειλεν
verses.transliteration: kai ouk echete autou ton logon menonta en hymin hoti hymeis ou pisteuete toutō hon ekeinos apesteilen
verses.literal: [nor] . . . [does] His - word abide in you because you {do} not believe the [One] . . . He sent

verses.original: Ἐραυνᾶτε τὰς γραφάς ὅτι ὑμεῖς δοκεῖτε ἐν αὐταῖς ἔχειν αἰώνιον ζωὴν καὶ ἐκεῖναί εἰσιν αἱ μαρτυροῦσαι περὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eraunate tas graphas hoti hymeis dokeite en autais echein aiōnion zōēn kai ekeinai eisin hai martyrousai peri emou
verses.literal: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life - These are the [very words that] testify about Me

verses.original: καὶ οὐ θέλετε ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἵνα ἔχητε ζωὴν
verses.transliteration: kai ou thelete elthein pros me hina echēte zōēn
verses.literal: yet vvv you refuse to come to Me to have life

verses.original: οὐ λαμβάνω Δόξαν παρὰ ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: ou lambanō Doxan para anthrōpōn
verses.literal: vvv I do not accept glory from men

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἔγνωκα ὑμᾶς ὅτι οὐκ ἔχετε τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: alla egnōka hymas hoti ouk echete tēn agapēn tou Theou en heautois
verses.literal: but I know you that vvv you do not have the love - of God within you

verses.original: ἐγὼ ἐλήλυθα ἐν μου τοῦ Πατρός τῷ ὀνόματι καὶ οὐ λαμβάνετέ με ἐὰν ἄλλος ἔλθῃ ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ τῷ ὀνόματι λήμψεσθε ἐκεῖνον
verses.transliteration: egō elēlytha en mou tou Patros tō onomati kai ou lambanete me ean allos elthē en tō idiō tō onomati lēmpsesthe ekeinon
verses.literal: I have come in My - Father’s - name and vvv you have not received Me [but] if someone else comes in [his] own - name you will receive him

verses.original: πῶς δύνασθε ὑμεῖς πιστεῦσαι λαμβάνοντες δόξαν παρὰ ἀλλήλων καὶ οὐ ζητεῖτε τὴν δόξαν τὴν παρὰ τοῦ μόνου Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: pōs dynasthe hymeis pisteusai lambanontes doxan para allēlōn kai ou zēteite tēn doxan tēn para tou monou Theou
verses.literal: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another yet vvv do not seek the glory that [comes] from the only God

verses.original: Μὴ δοκεῖτε ὅτι ἐγὼ κατηγορήσω ὑμῶν πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα ὁ ὑμῶν κατηγορῶν ἔστιν Μωϋσῆς εἰς ὃν ὑμεῖς ἠλπίκατε
verses.transliteration: Mē dokeite hoti egō katēgorēsō hymōn pros ton Patera ho hymōn katēgorōn estin Mōusēs eis hon hymeis ēlpikate
verses.literal: vvv Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father - Your accuser is Moses in whom you have put your hope

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ ἐπιστεύετε Μωϋσεῖ ἂν ἐπιστεύετε ἐμοί γὰρ ἐκεῖνος ἔγραψεν περὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar ei episteuete Mōusei an episteuete emoi gar ekeinos egrapsen peri emou
verses.literal: - If you had believed Moses vvv you would believe Me because he wrote about Me

verses.original: δὲ εἰ οὐ πιστεύετε τοῖς ἐκείνου γράμμασιν πῶς πιστεύσετε τοῖς ἐμοῖς ῥήμασιν
verses.transliteration: de ei ou pisteuete tois ekeinou grammasin pōs pisteusete tois emois rhēmasin
verses.literal: But since vvv you do not believe what he wrote how will you believe what I say
